description: Stop current playback on outputs (op "stop"), or cancel a pending/queued future-start job without disrupting current playback (op "cancel") — LoopPlayer.Stop / LoopPlayer.Cancel. Outputs is a list of integer output numbers (e.g. [1, 2]). This MUTATES the running/emulated system.

log.description: Log the stop/cancel to the Core event log (default false)

op.description: "stop" halts current playback; "cancel" aborts a queued future-start job

outputs.description: Output track numbers as an integer list, e.g. [1, 2]

name: qsys_loop_player_stop_cancel
title: Stop or cancel Loop Player playback
